profile.summary: Mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Chart.js, focusing on API configuration, scriptable chart properties, and high-quality technical documentation. Demonstrates precision in refining documentation, improving usability through examples, and maintaining code clarity. Familiar with interactive JavaScript development environments (jsbin, jsfiddle) and frontend JavaScript patterns. Contributions are primarily documentation-driven but reveal deep understanding of Chart.js internals and dynamic chart customization.
